title: Informed Consent
description: The user may not be fully aware of what data is being collected by the wearable device, leading to a lack of informed consent regarding the data sharing.

title: Data Integrity
description: The wearable device may not ensure the integrity of the data collected, leading to potential inaccuracies in the telemetry data that could affect user health assessments.

title: Data Disclosure
description: The wearable device may inadvertently disclose sensitive user data (e.g., GPS location) to unauthorized parties during data transmission or storage.

title: Data Disclosure from Wearable Device
description: The wearable device may unintentionally disclose personal data such as exercise sessions, GPS traces, and device ID when syncing with the companion app, potentially exposing this data to unauthorized parties.

title: Data Disclosure at Companion App
description: The companion app may store or process the received data in a way that could lead to unauthorized access or sharing of personal data, such as exercise sessions and GPS traces, with third parties.

title: Unawareness of Data Sharing
description: The user may not be fully aware that their personal data (calorie intake, meals, weight) is being shared with the companion app, leading to potential unawareness of data sharing practices.

title: Insecure Data Handling
description: The companion app may not implement adequate security measures to protect the personal data received from the user, leading to potential unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Lack of User Consent
description: The app may collect and store health logs without obtaining explicit consent from the user, leading to a lack of transparency regarding data usage.

title: Data Disclosure to Unauthorized Parties
description: The health log store may inadvertently disclose personal health data to unauthorized parties, either through inadequate access controls or data breaches.

title: Data Disclosure of GPS Location
description: The Companion Mobile App collects and writes GPS location traces with timestamps to the Location History Store, which may lead to the unintended disclosure of personal location data to unauthorized parties or systems.

title: Data Disclosure from Location History Store
description: The Location History Store may expose stored GPS location data to unauthorized access or sharing, leading to potential privacy violations for users.

title: Data Disclosure from Health Log Store
description: The Health Log Store (DS1) may disclose personal health data (calorie, weight, exercise logs) to the Health Analytics Service (P3) without proper consent or minimality principles being applied, leading to potential unauthorized access or sharing of sensitive information.

title: Data Disclosure by Health Analytics Service
description: The Health Analytics Service (P3) may process and analyze personal health data in a way that leads to unintended disclosures, such as through data aggregation or sharing results with third parties without proper safeguards, violating user privacy.

title: Data Disclosure of Location History
description: The location history data being shared from the Location History Store (DS2) to the Health Analytics Service (P3) may lead to the explicit or implicit disclosure of personal data, such as user movements and routines, which could be exploited or misused.

title: Inadequate Data Anonymization
description: The Health Analytics Service (P3) may inadequately anonymize or aggregate the location data received from the Location History Store (DS2), leading to potential identification of individuals based on their movement patterns.

title: Identifying Threats from Health Data
description: The analytics service may inadvertently reveal the identity of individuals through the inferred insights shared with the mobile app, especially if the data is not adequately anonymized or aggregated.

title: Profiling a Group of Individuals
description: The companion mobile app may use the health insights to profile groups of individuals, leading to potential discrimination or stigmatization based on inferred health conditions.

title: Insufficient Cybersecurity Risk Management
description: The data flow between the health analytics service and the mobile app may lack adequate cybersecurity measures, leading to potential breaches of personal health data and non-compliance with privacy regulations.

title: Linkability of User Data
description: The app may link user data to specific individuals, potentially allowing for identification of users based on their health trends and inferred condition indicators.

title: Data Disclosure to Unauthorized Parties
description: The user may inadvertently disclose sensitive health information to unauthorized parties through sharing or discussing the app's insights.

title: Non-compliance with Health Data Regulations
description: The app may not fully comply with health data regulations (e.g., HIPAA), leading to potential legal risks associated with the handling of sensitive health information.

title: Data Disclosure to Cloud Provider
description: The health analytics service shares sensitive health and location data with the cloud hosting provider, which may lead to unintended data disclosure if the provider does not have adequate security measures in place.

title: Data Disclosure by Cloud Provider
description: The cloud hosting provider may inadvertently disclose the hosted health analytics data to unauthorized parties, either through inadequate access controls or data breaches.
